name: return_immediately
description: A single return with no other work, so calling it does nothing. Its only static reference is as decoded gap bytes, so it reads as a stub.

name: increment_counter_set_state
description: Adds one to a shared counter, sets a shared state variable to 4, then calls one unnamed routine and returns. The reference run also records accesses to the interrupt request and custom chip registers.

name: wait_for_state_value
description: Calls an unnamed routine once, then keeps calling it until a base-relative state word holds a fixed target value. It acts as a polling wait loop.

name: map_index_through_table
description: Reads a byte from a fixed table at an index taken from a state word, and replaces table value 63 with the index plus a flag bit. If the result differs from the previous stored value it saves it as both the new previous and pending value, otherwise it clears the pending value.

name: store_matching_table_entries
description: When a pending word is nonzero, scans a zero-terminated list of four-word records and, for each record whose key matches the pending word, writes its second word through the pointer stored in the record. It then calls an unnamed routine after each match.

name: latch_masked_input_index
description: If the high bit of an input byte is set, it takes the low five bits as an index and compares index plus one with a stored index. On a difference it records the new index and sets a change flag, then clears the input byte.

name: write_strided_address_table
description: Computes a 32-bit address starting from two stored values and writes it five times as high and low word pairs into a fixed table, advancing 8000 bytes per entry. The table entries are spaced eight bytes apart, which suggests display plane pointers.

name: write_strided_address_entry
description: Has the same body as the preceding routine: it writes five high and low word address pairs spaced 8000 bytes apart into a fixed table. It is a second entry point into that setup.

name: toggle_state_and_pointer
description: Copies a stored state longword into a shared variable and calls an unnamed routine. It then flips the stored state between two fixed values and points a shared variable at one of two addresses depending on which value was present.

name: set_global_pointer_target
description: Stores one fixed address into a shared variable and returns. It is a one-line setter.

name: decode_joystick_state_mask
description: Decodes the direction bits of a joystick input word, XOR-combining each pair of bits, and adds a fire-button bit read from the CIA port A register. It stores the four-bit mask and a changed copy when the mask differs from the last one.

name: integrate_velocity_with_clamp
description: Adds a signed velocity into a position accumulator and clamps the position at an upper limit, or stops the velocity when it passes zero. When a mode flag equals one, it returns half the position.

name: scatter_copy_two_tables
description: Copies 31 consecutive words from a source table into a destination written every four bytes, then copies 16 more words into a second destination the same way.

name: scatter_copy_two_tables_entry
description: Has the same body as the preceding routine: it copies 31 and then 16 words from source tables into destinations spaced four bytes apart. It is a second entry point into that copy.

name: claim_free_slot_record
description: Scans fixed-size 20-byte records for one whose active word is zero, then stores four data words from the input registers and marks the record active. It does nothing when no record is free.

name: process_active_slot_records
description: Walks the same 20-byte record table and, for each record whose two status words are nonzero, calls an unnamed routine on that record.

name: deactivate_slot_record
description: Clears the active word of a 20-byte record and calls an unnamed routine. The code after the early return is unreachable in this decompiled form, so only the clear and the call are behaviour.

name: program_blitter_five_planes
description: Writes the blitter control, mask and modulo registers, then loops five times writing a source pointer, a destination pointer and a size word, advancing the destination by 8000 bytes each pass.

name: forward_slot_request_when_ready
description: When a record's signed status word is nonnegative, copies a request's values into the shared slot record if its stored index is valid, calls unnamed routines, and sets a completion flag when the record's own flag is zero.

name: prepare_software_interrupt_request
description: Stores a software-interrupt request word into a shared variable. When a pending flag is set it clears that flag and calls an unnamed routine.

name: set_request_word_if_nonzero
description: If a shared variable is nonzero, it is set to a fixed software-interrupt request word, otherwise nothing changes. The routine references the interrupt request register.

name: append_three_word_record
description: Writes three input words as a record into the next free slots of a shared list, then writes the end marker 12345 after them. It does nothing when the slot after the head already holds the marker 12346.

name: wait_for_blitter_completion
description: Writes a set-bit word to the DMA control register to enable blitter DMA, polls the blitter busy flag until it clears, then writes the clear-bit word to disable blitter DMA.

name: program_blitter_process_list
description: Calls an unnamed routine, sets the blitter control, mask and modulo registers for a copy, then calls an unnamed routine for each six-word list entry until the end marker. It finally resets the list head to the end marker.

name: set_blit_pointers_five_planes
description: Writes two modulo words from its input, then loops five times writing a source pointer, a destination pointer that advances 8000 bytes per pass, and a size word.

name: start_blit_with_fixed_offsets
description: Sets the blitter control, mask and modulo registers, then writes five source and destination pointer pairs at fixed offsets from a base value along with a size word. It calls an unnamed routine between passes.

name: write_blit_pointers_repeatedly
description: Repeatedly calls an unnamed routine to obtain a pair of addresses, writes them to the blitter pointer registers with a size word, and repeats for a count held in a register.

name: process_nonnegative_list_entries
description: Walks a shared list of three-word entries until the end marker, and calls an unnamed routine for each entry whose first word is nonnegative. It then resets the list head to the end marker.

name: append_entry_and_queue_blit
description: When its input is not the value minus one, it appends a six-word entry to the shared list and programs blitter modulo, mask and pointer registers. A flag selects between a four-pass and a three-pass variant, and the routine returns a count.

name: compute_clipped_offset_from_table
description: Looks up a record in a table by the low 12 bits of an input, takes two limit values from it, and clamps the input movement against those limits. It stores the resulting offset and a mask-table value for later use.

name: reset_double_buffer_slot_lists
description: Chooses one of two buffer areas from a toggle, clears eight record headers in it, clears an 18-entry counter table, and rebuilds an index table from the shared list of ready entries.

name: write_buffer_addresses_and_flip
description: Selects one of two buffer base addresses from a toggle, writes eight addresses 608 bytes apart into an eight-byte-stride table, and then flips the toggle.

name: write_mirrored_record_if_fits
description: Checks two bounds on a queued value and, when both pass, writes a four-byte record into two mirrored buffers and calls an unnamed routine. The decompiled output ends in unreadable instruction data after that call, so that tail is not described.

name: setup_blitter_copy_offset_write
description: Subtracts a masked input from a pointer value before a stack-relative write, calls an unnamed routine, then sets the blitter control, mask and modulo registers for a copy with source modulo four.

name: setup_blitter_copy_stack_write
description: Reads a pointer value and writes a stack-relative address, calls an unnamed routine, then sets the blitter control, mask and modulo registers for a copy with source modulo four.

name: setup_blitter_copy_indexed_write
description: Reads an input value and writes a stack-relative address after a second read, calls an unnamed routine, then sets the blitter control, mask and modulo registers for a copy with source modulo four.

name: setup_blitter_copy_after_call
description: Calls an unnamed routine after a self-copy of a pointer value, then sets the blitter control, mask and modulo registers for a copy with source modulo four. Most of the 159 instructions are not shown in the decompiled view, so only this setup is described.

name: setup_blitter_copy_registers
description: Calls an unnamed routine, then sets the blitter control, mask and modulo registers for a copy with source modulo four and destination modulo zero.

name: emit_command_sequence_for_flag
description: When a pending flag is nonzero, it clears the flag and writes one of two fixed value sequences into shared outputs, chosen by whether the stored value was 1. It then calls an unnamed routine.

name: load_indexed_value_and_call
description: Reads a word from a shared table at an index taken from a shared variable, stores it in another shared variable, then calls an unnamed routine.

name: tick_four_countdown_timers
description: Decrements four shared countdown variables by one each when they are nonzero, so each stops at zero.

name: wait_flag_clear_mark_byte
description: Busy-waits until a shared flag byte reads zero, clears a shared variable, and returns the input byte with bit 6 set.

name: call_when_flag_clear
description: Calls an unnamed routine when a shared variable is zero and always returns zero.

name: emit_channel_record_scaled
description: Returns zero when a state word is 4. Otherwise it stores a scaled value into a channel record and, when a pending flag is set, writes a two-word record and selects a new state before returning the scaled value.

name: emit_channel_record_from_base
description: Stores a scaled value into the channel record referenced by a base structure, and when a pending flag is set it writes two record words, sets a state, and chooses the next state from a sign field. The reference run lists interrupt and DMA registers as touched, but the code shown does not write them directly.

name: advance_gated_countdown
description: Calls three unnamed routines, then when a gate flag is set and a value is nonzero, calls an unnamed routine if a byte counter is zero or has just reached zero after a decrement.

name: call_on_countdown_struct
description: When a second structure field is nonzero, calls an unnamed routine if a byte counter in the structure is zero or has just reached zero after a decrement, and otherwise returns the stored value.

name: step_two_stage_ramp_value
description: Advances a two-stage ramp: the first stage raises a value by a table step until it reaches a limit, and the second lowers it by another table step toward a floor and holds there. A countdown ends the sequence, and a zero sequence flag resets the stages.

name: advance_three_record_command_streams
description: Processes three command-stream records, each with an active pointer. It reads a byte from each stream: the escape value sets a scaled parameter from the following byte, and any other value selects an index that reinitialises the record's timing and state. Per-step counters decrement and unnamed routines are called as they expire.

name: read_stream_command_for_record
description: Reads one command byte from a record's stream: the escape value sets a scaled parameter from the next byte, and any other value reinitialises the record's timing, pointers and state. It then steps the record's counters.

name: copy_word_field_triples
description: Copies two word fields to two other offsets in a structure, advancing the base pointer two bytes per pass, and repeats for three passes.

name: copy_word_field_pairs
description: Copies two word fields to two other offsets in a structure, advancing the base pointer two bytes per pass, and repeats for two passes.

name: rebuild_level_pointer_table
description: Sets a shared rate word to 64, loads a table word indexed by a shared byte, and scans a sorted byte table for the first entry above a counter. It then fills a 30-entry pointer table at a computed stride, zeroes four level words and clears several shared variables.

name: scale_four_channel_volumes
description: Multiplies four stored channel level words by a masked factor and shifts the product right six bits, writing each to a shared output. A factor of 64 passes the levels through unchanged. The reference run lists the four audio volume registers as touched.

name: enter_level_table_rebuild
description: Two-instruction entry point that touches its argument byte, then runs the same level pointer table rebuild as the earlier routine at the preceding entry.

name: reset_levels_then_rebuild
description: Two-instruction entry point that clears four level words and then runs the same level pointer table rebuild described for the earlier routine.

name: enter_rebuild_after_store
description: Two-instruction entry point that stores a value and then runs the same level pointer table rebuild described for the earlier routine.

name: enter_level_table_rebuild_direct
description: Two-instruction entry point that runs the same level pointer table rebuild described for the earlier routine without the preceding store.

name: reset_levels_then_rebuild_b
description: Two-instruction entry point that clears four level words and then runs the same level pointer table rebuild described for the earlier routine, reached from a separate call site.

name: enter_level_table_rebuild_tail
description: Two-instruction entry point that runs the same level pointer table rebuild described for the earlier routine.

name: rebuild_level_table_alt_entry
description: Runs the same level pointer table rebuild described for the earlier routine, reached through a separate entry. The reference run lists the four audio volume registers as touched.

name: clear_channel_levels_set_mask
description: Zeroes four channel level words and a shared variable, clears a shared pointer-flag word, and sets another shared variable to 15. The reference run lists the four audio volume registers and the DMA control register as touched.

name: set_audio_location_pointers
description: Advances a channel step counter. When the counter wraps it sets the DMA enable bit after a delay and writes location pointers for the audio channels, skipping the last two when the counter is below a threshold. Otherwise it calls unnamed routines and walks the channel state table.

name: mark_table_entry_active
description: Sets one byte of a shared table, at an index taken from a register, to 1.

name: program_audio_channel_registers
description: Per the reference run it writes the location and length registers of all four audio channels and the DMA control register, and calls three unnamed routines and a masking routine. The decompiler output timed out, so no behaviour beyond these register accesses is described.

name: update_audio_period_by_effect
description: Updates a channel's 12-bit audio period according to the low nibble of a command byte: it loads a value from a note table, slides the period up or down, or steps it with a clamp. The period is clamped to the Amiga range of 113 to 856 and written to the channel's output word.

name: install_jump_vectors_and_run
description: Checks a flag and calls unnamed routines, reads the fire-button bit from the CIA port A register to choose a value, writes jump instructions into a memory block, and calls through a stored pointer. It references the text FB_PilotsLog.

name: set_fixed_long_constant
description: Stores a fixed 32-bit constant into a shared variable and returns.

name: setup_trap_vector_and_poll
description: Writes a return instruction and a no-op into low memory, triggers trap 0, sets stack and address values, calls unnamed routines, and polls a shared flag before calling through a stored pointer.

name: copy_code_blocks_into_place
description: Clears a shared variable, writes jump instructions into memory, and copies several blocks of longwords from fixed source addresses to destination addresses, including blocks of 176 and 508 longwords. It references the text FB_Save.

name: call_and_pass_d1
description: Calls an unnamed routine and returns the second data register unchanged. It references the text FB_PilotsLog, which the code does not use directly.

name: call_and_pass_d1_entry
description: Same as the preceding routine: it calls an unnamed routine and returns the second data register unchanged, referencing the same text.

name: clear_buffer_and_copy_blocks
description: Clears a 16 KB buffer, copies a run of 512-byte blocks from a source pointer into the buffer at an offset given by a block number, and calls an unnamed routine with zero.

name: copy_blocks_from_buffer
description: Copies a run of 512-byte blocks out of a buffer at a block offset into a destination pointer, then returns the offset value.

name: copy_byte_run_then_call
description: Copies a run of bytes from a source to a destination using a word count, then calls an unnamed routine and returns the second parameter. It references the text FB_Save, which the copy does not use directly.

name: call_and_pass_d0_d1
description: Calls an unnamed routine and returns the first two data registers unchanged.

name: poll_fire_button_with_timeout
description: Calls an unnamed routine, and for one of its return values repeatedly waits on a video position byte. It keeps looping while the fire-button bit of the CIA port A register stays high and a 16-bit counter has not run out. The reference run lists the video position register as touched.

name: call_dispatch_entry_40
description: Calls the routine stored at byte offset 40 from a base pointer held in a shared variable, then returns the data registers unchanged.

name: call_dispatch_entry_8
description: Calls the routine stored at byte offset 8 from a base pointer held in a shared variable, then returns the data registers unchanged.

name: call_dispatch_entry_12
description: Calls the routine stored at byte offset 12 from a base pointer held in a shared variable, then returns the data registers unchanged.

name: call_global_function_pointer
description: Calls the routine whose address is stored at byte offset 36 from a pointer held in a shared variable.

name: stub_bad_instruction_data
description: The decompiler hit bad instruction data at the start, so no readable routine body exists here. It is a stub of undecodable bytes, not a behaviour to describe.

name: stub_bad_instruction_data
description: The decompiler hit bad instruction data at the start, so no readable routine body exists here. It is a stub of undecodable bytes, not a behaviour to describe.

name: stub_bad_instruction_data
description: The decompiler hit bad instruction data at the start, so no readable routine body exists here. It is a stub of undecodable bytes, not a behaviour to describe.

name: boot_block_load_and_jump
description: Boot block entry: sets up a device I/O request with command 2, a data address and a length, and calls the exec library DoIO routine. It then runs trap and address setup, checks status, and transfers control to a loaded program through a stored address, looping forever if a check fails.

name: run_boot_load_sequence
description: Calls a trap and a series of unnamed routines with status checks, writes address words into low memory, then transfers control to a loaded program through a stored address. A failed check leads into an infinite loop.

name: enter_boot_status_checks
description: Runs the same status-check and transfer sequence as the preceding routine, entered after a low-memory write without the initial trap. A failed check leads into an infinite loop.

name: run_boot_sequence_with_stub
description: Writes address words into low memory, calls an empty stub and several unnamed routines with status checks, then transfers control to a loaded program through a stored address. A failed check leads into an infinite loop.

name: initialise_display_and_copper
description: Clears a bit in a CIA control register and sets its direction bits, then writes the display window, data fetch, bitplane modulo and control registers, and the copper list pointer. It also sets DMA and interrupt enable words, per the reference run, and stores a fixed address in a shared variable.

name: clear_shared_block_sixteen_longs
description: Clears sixteen longwords of a shared block starting at a fixed address. The reference run lists the background colour register as touched.

name: copy_sixteen_longs_from_source
description: Copies sixteen longwords from a fixed source block into a shared block. The reference run lists the background colour register as touched.

name: walk_sector_range_by_track
description: Splits a sector number into a track and a sector within the track, using 11 sectors per track, after a range check. It then walks the requested run in 512-byte steps, calling unnamed routines for each step and advancing the destination pointer.

name: fill_buffer_with_gap_pattern
description: Fills 417 longwords starting at a shared pointer with a fixed alternating-bit pattern, skipping the fill when its first longword already holds that pattern.

name: scan_sector_slots_for_marker
description: Scans up to 11 sector slots. When the slot index is zero it reads a byte and returns once that byte is below 11, otherwise it marks the current table entry as missing.

name: skip_gap_then_seek_marker
description: Calls three unnamed routines for each of a counted number of passes, then calls an unnamed routine up to 11 times until it returns the value 28, and returns.

name: blit_mfm_decode_pass
description: Programs the blitter control, size and source, mask and destination pointers in two passes, using values computed from a sector offset and a length. It then calls unnamed routines to finish the pass, which appears to decode MFM track data in a track buffer.

name: advance_sector_index_mod_eleven
description: Computes a sector index modulo 11 from two inputs, then repeats for a count. Each step calls an unnamed routine and advances the index, wrapping to zero after 10.

name: start_blitter_copy_pass
description: Computes three blitter pointer values from an input and offsets, programs the blitter control and size registers for a two-row copy, and then calls an unnamed routine.

name: validate_sector_header_and_data
description: Checks a sector's sync markers and header fields against the expected values, returning one of the error codes 21 to 26 on a mismatch. Otherwise it returns a byte from the header.

name: update_clock_bit_from_previous
description: Reads a byte and the flag bit 0 of the byte before it. When that flag is clear it sets bit 7 unless bit 6 is already set, and otherwise it clears bit 7. The byte is written back, which resembles MFM clock-bit insertion.

name: verify_sector_checksum
description: XOR-accumulates the masked data bits of ten longwords and compares the result with a checksum computed from header longwords and a second value. It returns 0 when both checks match and 27 otherwise.

name: decode_mfm_long_pair
description: Extracts the data bits from an odd and an even longword by masking each with the alternating-bit pattern, shifting the even one left by one, and combining the two results.

name: xor_checksum_table
description: XORs a run of longwords together, with the count derived from a size input, and masks the running value with the alternating-bit pattern before returning it.

name: shift_bits_across_long_pair
description: Shifts a longword and the word after it by the same count and combines the shifted parts into one longword, realigning bitstream data.

name: call_three_routines_in_sequence
description: Calls three unnamed routines in order and returns with no result.

name: combine_data_and_clock_mask
description: Masks an input longword to its alternating data bits, derives a matching clock-bit mask from it, and stores the combined longword through a pointer. It clears the mask's sign bit when the flag byte before the stored word is set.

name: search_sync_pattern_offset
description: Scans a stream of words for a sync pattern and its alternate, returning the bit offset of the matching word within the stream, or -1 when no match is found within the length.

name: copy_or_blit_shifted_word
description: When its flag is set, it copies the preceding word to a destination pointer. Otherwise it programs the blitter control, shift, size and pointer registers from its inputs and calls an unnamed routine.

name: start_blitter_decode_pass
description: Programs the blitter control, size and pointer registers for a decode pass, using a shifted parameter and a computed size, then calls an unnamed routine.

name: wait_blitter_ready_poll
description: Busy-waits while the blitter busy bit in a hardware status byte is set, then returns.

name: initialise_blitter_fill_state
description: Writes a DMA control word, sets the blitter mask registers to all ones, writes an alternating fill pattern to the blitter C data register, and clears the two blitter modulo registers.

name: start_disk_dma_read
description: When the zero flag is set, it loads the disk buffer pointer, sets the MFM mode bits in the ADK control register, enables disk DMA, and starts a read of a fixed length by writing the length register twice. The read direction bit is left clear.

name: start_disk_dma_write
description: When a status bit is set, it loads the disk buffer pointer, sets the MFM precompensation bit in the ADK control register, enables disk DMA, and starts a write of a fixed length. It returns the result of an unnamed routine in that case, and 28 otherwise.

name: wait_disk_transfer_done
description: Polls the interrupt request register for the disk block bit for up to 400000 passes. On success it clears the disk length register, acknowledges the interrupt request and returns 0; on timeout it returns minus one.

name: deselect_drive_bit
description: Clears one drive-select bit in the CIA-B port B register, with the bit chosen from a stored drive index.

name: wait_drive_ready_status
description: Sets the CIA-B port B register to all ones, calls two unnamed routines, then polls the drive-ready bit of the CIA-A port A register for a fixed count. It returns 0 once the bit clears and 34 on timeout.

name: seek_drive_to_track
description: Compares the stored track position with the target track, steps the head once for each track of difference, records the new position and returns zero. It calls an unnamed routine first when the stored position is negative.

name: step_head_until_track_zero
description: Calls an unnamed routine on each attempt until the track-zero bit in CIA-A port A reads clear, for up to 86 attempts. It then zeroes the stored track position and returns 0, or returns 30 if the sensor never clears.

name: set_drive_control_bits
description: Calls an unnamed routine to obtain a value, clears bit 1 of the CIA-B port B register when that value is nonnegative, sets bit 0, writes the register, and then calls another unnamed routine.

name: write_drive_port_then_delay
description: Writes the value returned by an unnamed routine to the CIA-B port B register, then busy-waits for 15000 iterations.

name: busy_wait_count_loop
description: Busy-waits by decrementing a count register until it reaches zero, then returns.

name: build_drive_select_bits
description: Builds a CIA-B port value by setting the high bits and clearing one bit chosen from a stored drive index, then clears a second bit when that drive's stored flag is set. It returns the value without writing it.

name: run_boot_jump_sequence
description: Installs a trap handler, writes address words into low memory, calls unnamed routines, polls a status bit, and then jumps through a stored address.

name: run_boot_poll_then_jump
description: Writes address words into low memory, calls unnamed routines and polls a status bit, then jumps through a stored address. It is entered from a short routine that loads a small constant first.

name: initialise_copper_display_modes
description: Writes the display control registers for plane modulos, bitplane control, data fetch and display window, then the copper list pointer and the DMA and interrupt enable words. It also clears a CIA control bit and stores fixed values in shared variables.

name: fill_shared_block_with_ones
description: Fills 128 words of a shared block starting at a fixed address with the value 65535.

name: fill_descending_longword_table
description: Writes a table of 200 longwords, counting down from 40000 in steps of 200. The reference run lists the fire-button register, DMA control and interrupt enable as touched.

name: install_exception_vector_stubs
description: Writes ten consecutive vector addresses into low memory starting at address 8, each two bytes after the previous one, all pointing at a routine.

name: forward_to_unnamed_routine
description: The decompiler timed out. From the facts alone this is a single-instruction entry, referenced by address, that calls one unnamed routine.

name: subtract_memory_then_call
description: The decompiler timed out. From the facts alone this is a 14-instruction routine with one caller, an absolute subtract to memory, and one call to an unnamed routine.

name: start_copper_with_sprite_zero
description: The decompiler timed out, so this is described from the facts alone. It writes the background colour, the copper list pointer and jump, the sprite 0 position, and the DMA and interrupt enable words, and calls four unnamed routines.

name: draw_text_glyph_stream
description: Reads a code stream: a code of 1 sets the draw position from the next two bytes, 255 ends the stream, and any other code selects an eight-byte glyph from a table starting at code 32 and writes its rows at a 40-byte pitch.

name: stub_return_only
description: A single return instruction with no work. It is only referenced by address.

name: draw_text_rows_from_stream
description: Reads a start position from two bytes, then draws glyphs from the stream until a code of 1 begins a new position or 255 ends the routine. Glyph rows are written at a 40-byte pitch.

name: convert_longword_to_nibble_chars
description: Splits a longword into eight 4-bit values and stores each as a character from a 16-entry table, writing the characters into a buffer from the end backwards.

name: draw_nibble_digits_at_position
description: Rotates a longword one nibble at a time, maps each nibble to a glyph index with letters adjusted above nine, and draws eight glyphs in a row at a 40-byte pitch from a base pointer.

name: decode_serial_key_byte
description: Reads the CIA-A serial data register. In one of two states it decodes the byte, inverting and rotating it right by one bit, stores the result in a shared table and starts a handshake timer. In the other state it clears a CIA control bit and sets a shared variable to 32767.

name: clear_key_table_entry
description: Clears a table entry selected by the low seven bits of a key number, clears bit 1 of the following byte, and sets a shared variable to 8. The reference run lists the interrupt request register as touched.

name: set_serial_input_mode
description: Clears bit 6 of the CIA-A control register A, which selects serial input direction, and sets a shared variable to 32767.

name: normalise_table_bytes_to_two
description: Walks 128 entries of a shared byte table at a stride of two, setting each to 0 when it equals 1 and to 2 otherwise.

name: store_two_interrupt_words
description: Stores two fixed words, 255 and 32, into shared variables. The reference run lists the interrupt request registers as touched.

name: poll_bit_and_shift_history
description: Stores a shared value, polls a shared status bit until it is set, shifts three history values along by one, and returns that status bit.

name: flip_sign_bit_byte_run
description: Walks a run of bytes that starts at a fixed address and runs down to address zero, flipping bit 7 of each byte. Eight unnamed routines call it.

name: flip_sign_bit_entry
description: Performs the same sign-bit flip over a byte run as the preceding routine.

name: install_vectors_then_wait_fire
description: Writes eight consecutive longword pointers into low memory starting at address 8, calls an unnamed routine, waits until the fire-button bit of CIA-A port A clears, then calls another unnamed routine.

name: setup_audio_channels_with_delays
description: Calls an unnamed routine, then writes DMA control words and period values for the audio channels. When a shared flag is set it writes location, length, volume and period registers for four channels with busy-wait delays between them, then sets the DMA and interrupt enable words.

name: stub_return_only
description: A single return instruction with no work. It is only referenced by address.

name: silence_audio_channel_data
description: Writes 15 to the DMA control word and then zeros the four audio sample data registers.

name: service_audio_channel_interrupts
description: Reads the interrupt request bits for the four audio channels and, for each set channel, copies the next pointer and length values into that channel's registers. It then writes the interrupt request acknowledgements.

name: service_audio_channel_interrupts_alt
description: Performs the same audio channel interrupt service as the preceding routine. The reference run also lists the colour and DMA and interrupt status registers as touched.

name: wait_while_entry_negative
